Title: Rishabh's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rishabh - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Riya - 11 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Sonali - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Rishabh stands in the park. Riya and Sonali stand near him.]

Sonali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rishabh does push-ups.]

Sonali (excited): "Show me too!"

[Rishabh does yoga on a mat.]

Riya (happily): "This is amazing!"

[Riya skips rope.]

Sonali: "What next?"

Scene 2: The snowy hillside - Day

Sonali: "Let's begin."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Rishabh (surprised): "Listen!"

[Rishabh builds a snowman.]

Rishabh (happily): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rishabh slides down the snowy slope.]

Rishabh (laughing): "This is amazing!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Rishabh stands in the living room. Riya and Sonali stand near him.]

Riya: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh puts on his school uniform.]

Riya: "Mom, look at this."

[Riya puts on red lipstick.]

Riya: "I'm ready!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Night

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Riya stand near him.]

Riya: "Mom, look over here."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Rishabh (gently): "Oh wow!"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Riya (softly): "What a day to remember!"
